about: The games database's schema as pg_dump 17 writes it (playdb.check, layer 1 + 3): every entry byte for byte, the data entries' COPY lines, the sequences. Made from the real migrations (play/db.mjs, schema 2) by tests/fixtures/play/README.md's recipe; regenerate it there when the games schema or the postgres image changes.

entries.FUNCTION|play_append_only():
CREATE FUNCTION public.play_append_only() RETURNS trigger
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'play: % is append-only', TG_TABLE_NAME USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege'; END $$;
entries.INDEX|play_accounts_wid: CREATE INDEX play_accounts_wid ON public.play_accounts USING btree (wid) WHERE (wid IS NOT NULL);
entries.INDEX|play_entries_account: CREATE INDEX play_entries_account ON public.play_entries USING btree (account);

entries.INDEX|play_games_one_open: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX play_games_one_open ON public.play_games USING btree (table_id) WHERE (disposition = 'open'::text);
entries.INDEX|play_seats_one_active: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX play_seats_one_active ON public.play_seats USING btree (wid) WHERE active;
entries.INDEX|play_seats_one_per_person: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX play_seats_one_per_person ON public.play_seats USING btree (person) WHERE (active AND (person IS NOT NULL));
entries.INDEX|play_tables_one_open: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX play_tables_one_open ON public.play_tables USING btree (room, game) WHERE (status = 'open'::text);

CREATE SEQUENCE public.play_spaces_sid_seq
    START WITH 1
    INCREMENT BY 1
    NO MINVALUE
    NO MAXVALUE
    CACHE 1;
entries.TABLE|play_accounts:
CREATE TABLE public.play_accounts (
    id text NOT NULL,
    sid bigint NOT NULL,
    kind text NOT NULL,
    wid text,
    balance bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT play_accounts_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['w'::text, 'seat'::text, 'pot'::text, 'esc'::text, 'mint'::text, 'burn'::text, 'bank'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT play_accounts_nonneg CHECK (((kind = ANY (ARRAY['mint'::text, 'burn'::text, 'bank'::text])) OR (balance >= 0))),
    CONSTRAINT play_accounts_owned CHECK (((kind = ANY (ARRAY['mint'::text, 'burn'::text, 'bank'::text])) = (wid IS NULL)))
);
entries.TABLE|play_games:
CREATE TABLE public.play_games (
    id text NOT NULL,
    table_id text NOT NULL,
    sid bigint NOT NULL,
    kind text NOT NULL,
    n integer NOT NULL,
    disposition text DEFAULT 'open'::text NOT NULL,
    version bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    log jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    finished_at timestamp with time zone,
    CONSTRAINT play_games_disposition_check CHECK ((disposition = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'settled'::text, 'voided'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT play_games_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['hand'::text, 'round'::text])))
);
entries.TABLE|play_seats:
CREATE TABLE public.play_seats (
    table_id text NOT NULL,
    wid text NOT NULL,
    sid bigint NOT NULL,
    active boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    joined_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    left_at timestamp with time zone,
    person text
);
entries.TABLE|play_tables:
CREATE TABLE public.play_tables (
    id text NOT NULL,
    game text NOT NULL,
    room text NOT NULL,
    space_id text NOT NULL,
    sid bigint NOT NULL,
    owner text NOT NULL,
    status text DEFAULT 'open'::text NOT NULL,
    opts jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
    state jsonb,
    version bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    closed_at timestamp with time zone,
    closed_reason text,
    summary jsonb,
    CONSTRAINT play_tables_game_check CHECK ((game = ANY (ARRAY['holdem'::text, 'rig'::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT play_tables_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'closed'::text])))
);
entries.TABLE|play_tombstones:

entries.TABLE|play_tx:
CREATE TABLE public.play_tx (

    idem_key text NOT NULL,
    ref text

entries.TABLE|play_wallets:
CREATE TABLE public.play_wallets (
    wid text NOT NULL,
    sid bigint NOT NULL,
    rank integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    accrual_s integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    credited_through timestamp with time zone,
    day text,
    earned_today integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    topup_day text,
    allow_pranks boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    version bigint DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT play_wallets_accrual_s_check CHECK ((accrual_s >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT play_wallets_earned_today_check CHECK ((earned_today >= 0)),
    CONSTRAINT play_wallets_rank_check CHECK ((rank >= 0))
);
entries.TRIGGER|play_accounts play_accounts_fixe: CREATE TRIGGER play_accounts_fixed BEFORE UPDATE ON public.play_accounts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.play_account_fixed();

entries.TRIGGER|play_entries play_entries_apply: CREATE TRIGGER play_entries_apply AFTER INSERT ON public.play_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.play_entry_apply();
entries.TRIGGER|play_entries play_entries_balanc: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER play_entries_balanced AFTER INSERT ON public.play_entries DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.play_tx_balanced();
entries.TRIGGER|play_entries play_entries_ro: CREATE TRIGGER play_entries_ro BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.play_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.play_append_only();
entries.TRIGGER|play_tx play_tx_ro: CREATE TRIGGER play_tx_ro BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.play_tx FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.play_append_only();
